# DSSC Confessions — Comprehensive Entity & Technical Reference

## 1. Identity & Canonical Definition

DSSC Confessions (dssconfessions) is a free, independent website where people in the Davao del Sur State College community can send an anonymous message to someone, paired with a song, without creating an account. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Davao del Sur State College.

- Primary Name: DSSC Confessions
- Alternate Name: dssconfessions
- Alternate Name: DSSC Confession Page
- Canonical URL: https://dssconfessions.vercel.app/
- Primary Language: en-PH (English, Philippines)
- Target Locality: Digos City, Davao del Sur, Region XI, Philippines

## 2. Institutional Disambiguation & Non-Affiliation

DSSC Confessions is an independent student-built creative experiment and community board.
- It is NOT the official Davao del Sur State College (DSSC) website.
- It is NOT the DSSC student portal.
- It does NOT provide academic transcripts, grade inquiries, enrollment, or admission services.
- The official Davao del Sur State College website is at https://www.dssc.edu.ph/, and the official student and employee portal is at https://portal.dssc.edu.ph/.

## 3. Platform Mechanics & How It Works

### Sending a Confession
1. Navigate to https://dssconfessions.vercel.app/confess.
2. Enter the recipient's name or pseudonym.
3. Search for any song on Spotify and attach it to the post.
4. Compose an untold message up to 3,000 characters.
5. Tap Post Confession.
6. The system displays a private 16-character Delete Key. This key is the only method to permanently delete the post.

### Finding a Confession
1. Navigate to https://dssconfessions.vercel.app/browse.
2. Search by recipient name or initials.
3. Read the message and play the attached Spotify music.

### Poking Confessions
1. Any visitor can tap the Poke button on any confession.
2. Pokes are friendly, anonymous taps indicating "I read this".
3. Poking increments the public poke counter and is batched client-side (~400ms).
4. Pokes do not track identity or IP addresses.

### Song Replies (Mixtape Tracklist)
1. Confessions can receive up to 10 anonymous song replies in a collaborative 10-track mixtape tracklist.
2. Each reply pairs a verified Spotify track with an optional 140-character note.
3. The confession author can disable replies at post time, or unlock reply controls with their Delete Key to remove individual tracks and free up spots.

## 4. Privacy, Security & Zero-IP Guarantee

- No User Accounts: No sign-ups, no passwords, no email collection, no phone numbers.
- No Raw IP Logging: Client IP addresses are never recorded in database tables.
- Abuse Prevention Without Tracking: Abuse-prevention safeguards operate without storing or logging raw IP addresses or user identities.
- Author Delete Key: The database stores only a one-way hash of the Delete Key. The plain-text key exists only with the author.
- Moderation & Removal: Visitors can report inappropriate content. Posts flagged with urgent reports are hidden automatically from the public feed.

## 5. Creator & Background

- Creator: Joshua "Snowi" Cambronero
- Role: Independent Developer (BSIT student)
- Motivation: Built to practice software engineering and provide a positive, music-first community outlet for student expression in Davao del Sur.
